_about: Power BI visual rules, each backed by a Microsoft Learn line. Source of truth for the 'visual rule' shorts, the agents' rules file and the PBIR checker. Severity is our judgement of impact on the reader; learnStrength is how strongly Learn words it. verified = the quote was checked against Learn in this repo's own fact-check (false = taken from the research report, check before using on screen).

severities.warning: Makes the report harder to read

rules.quote: Don't exceed three or four numerals when displaying numbers. Display measures to one or two numerals left of the decimal point and scale for thousands or millions. For example, use 3.4 million instead of 3,400,000.
rules.checkHint: display units on labels/card values, or the measure's format string

rules.rule: Cut data labels you don't need
rules.quote: Avoid cluttering your charts with data labels that aren't needed.
rules.checkHint: labels shown on a chart with many categories or series

rules.rule: Avoid acronyms or jargon in titles
rules.quote: Avoid using acronyms or jargon in your report titles.
rules.checkHint: all-caps tokens in visual titles

rules.rule: Pie charts: fewer than eight categories
rules.quote: Pie charts are best if they have fewer than eight categories.
rules.checkHint: pieChart/donutChart visuals; category count needs a model query

rules.rule: Try not to mix millions and thousands on one axis
rules.quote: Try to avoid mixing large and small measures on the same scale... If you need to mix, choose a visualization like a combo chart that allows the use of a second axis.
rules.checkHint: two or more measures on one value axis; magnitudes need the model

rules.rule: Be careful with 3D and axes that don't start at zero
rules.quote: Be careful when you use charts that distort reality, such as 3-D charts and charts that don't start at zero.
rules.checkHint: custom 3D visuals; value-axis start set above zero on bar/column charts

rules.rule: No visuals Microsoft is retiring
rules.quote: Avoid creating visuals scheduled for deprecation, including Q&A, Bing Maps, and filled maps.
rules.checkHint: visualType qnaVisual, map or filledMap

rules.rule: Sort every visual on purpose
rules.quote: Pay attention to how charts are sorted. If you want to draw attention to the highest or lowest number, sort by the measure.
rules.checkHint: no explicit sort definition on the visual

rules.rule: Keep scales, order and colours consistent
rules.quote: Be consistent with chart scales on axes, chart dimension ordering, and the colors used for dimension values within charts.
rules.checkHint: per-visual colour overrides for the same category value that differ

rules.rule: Try to avoid mixing time frames
rules.quote: Try to avoid mixing levels of precision and time... Don't have one chart that has last month next to filtered charts from a specific month of the year.
rules.checkHint: different date filters across visuals on one page

rules.rule: Put the top-level number top-left
rules.quote: Put the highest level of data at the top left corner and show more detail as you move in the direction the audience uses for reading (left-to-right, top-to-bottom).
rules.checkHint: the card/KPI visual nearest x=0, y=0

rules.rule: Same title size everywhere, slicers in the same place
rules.quote: Use the same font size for all visual titles, just as you should for data labels and axis titles. If you use slicers on multiple report pages, keep them in the same location on every page of your report.
rules.checkHint: title font sizes and slicer positions across pages

rules.rule: Text contrast at least 4.5:1
rules.quote: Ensure color contrast between title, axis label, and data label text and the background are at least 4.5:1.
rules.checkHint: font colour vs background in theme and visual overrides

rules.rule: Avoid colour as the only signal
rules.quote: Avoid using color (including features conditional formatting) as the only way of conveying information. Instead, use markers to convey different series.
rules.checkHint: multi-series line/area/scatter charts with markers off

rules.rule: Avoid red with green in one chart
rules.quote: Certain color combinations can be difficult for users to distinguish. These combinations include the following: green and red... Avoid using these colors together in a chart or on the same report page.
rules.checkHint: hue pairs in theme dataColors and overrides

rules.rule: Alt text on every visual that carries meaning
rules.quote: Ensure alt text is added to all non-decorative visuals on the page.
rules.checkHint: missing altText on non-decorative visuals

rules.rule: Take decorative items out of the tab order
rules.quote: Set tab order and turn off tab order (mark the item as hidden) on any decorative items.
rules.checkHint: shapes/images still in the tab order

rules.rule: Don't hide key facts in tooltips
rules.quote: Don't use tooltips to convey important information. Users with motor problems and users who don't use a mouse have difficulties accessing them.
rules.checkHint: needs a human read

rules.rule: Keep visuals per page to what's necessary
rules.quote: It's highly recommended you limit the number of visuals on a particular report page to only what is necessary.
rules.checkHint: visual count per page; the threshold is ours, Learn gives none

rules.rule: 10-20 fields per visual at most
rules.quote: We recommend limiting visuals to 10-20 total fields, both for readability and performance reasons.
rules.checkHint: projection count in the visual's query

rules.rule: Top N filter on big tables
rules.quote: The solution: use the "Top N" filter to reduce the max number of items that the table displays.
rules.checkHint: table/matrix visuals without a Top N filter

rules.rule: On mobile, no fonts under 9 pt
rules.quote: Don't use fonts smaller than nine points.
rules.checkHint: font sizes in the mobile layout
